title: Multisample Flow Matching: Straightening Flows with Minibatch Couplings
tldr_zh: 把 FM 的独立耦合换成 batch 内 OT/稳定匹配耦合，ImageNet 上同 FID 省 30–60% NFE，训练开销 <4%。
tldr_en: Marginal-preserving minibatch couplings (BatchOT/EOT/Stable) for flow matching: lower gradient variance, straighter flows, 30-60% fewer NFEs on ImageNet.
key_numbers: ImageNet-32 FID 4.68 @146 NFE (BatchOT) vs 5.04 @139 (FM-CondOT), NLL 3.58 both (Table 6)
NFE to reach FID=10 on ImageNet-32: 14 (BatchOT/Stable) vs 20 (CondOT), >=40 diffusion (Table 1)
NFE to reach FID=20 on ImageNet-64: 12 (BatchOT) vs 29 (CondOT) (Table 1)
Joint CFM value at convergence on 2D: BatchOT 0.24 vs CondOT 10.72 (Fig. 2)
